printf '%s
' "node=$NODE_NAME"
printf '%s
' "identity:"
id
printf '%s
' "client_candidates:"
for c in mariadb mysql; do
  p=$(command -v "$c" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$p" ]; then printf '%s
' "$c=$p"; fi
done
client=$(command -v mariadb 2>/dev/null || command -v mysql 2>/dev/null || true)
printf '%s
' "protected_config_metadata:"
sudo -n find /etc/mysql /root -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.cnf' -o -name '.my.cnf' \) -printf '%p %u %m

printf '%s
' "admin_auth_methods:"
if [ -z "$client" ]; then
  printf '%s
' "no_client_found"
else
  printf '%s
' "client=$client"
  printf '%s
' "method=sudo-H-socket-defaults"
  sudo -n -H "$client" --protocol=socket --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT 'AUTH_OK',USER(),@@hostname;" 2>&1
  printf 'status=%s
' "$?"
  for cfg in /etc/mysql/debian.cnf /root/.my.cnf; do
    if sudo -n test -f "$cfg" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf '%s
' "method=sudo-H-socket-config=$cfg"
      sudo -n -H "$client" --defaults-extra-file="$cfg" --protocol=socket --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT 'AUTH_OK',USER(),@@hostname;" 2>&1
      printf 'status=%s
' "$?"
    fi
  done
fi
